paragraphs: I am a Program Manager with PMP certification, AWS Solutions Architect Professional, and five Google Cloud Professional certifications. With 20+ years of professional experience including 13 years of nonprofit program management, I specialize in bridging complex technical solutions with stakeholder-driven program execution—delivering cloud architectures, coordinating cross-functional teams, and translating technical concepts for diverse audiences.

My unique value proposition combines program management rigor with hands-on cloud expertise. I bring proven ability to scale programs (400% growth over 13 years), manage budgets ($42K annual), deliver 100+ stakeholder presentations, and coordinate teams of 50+ members—backed by technical credentials that enable me to architect solutions, evaluate vendor proposals, and communicate effectively with both executive leadership and engineering teams.

Technical portfolio highlights include: AWS portfolio migration achieving 80% cost reduction with 100% uptime and sub-500ms API response times; real-time IoT data pipeline on Google Cloud using Pub/Sub, BigQuery, and Looker Studio; and AI-powered customer support chatbot using Dialogflow CX and Vertex AI (Gemini 2.0) reducing manual inquiries by 60%.

I'm currently seeking Program Manager, Solutions Engineer, or Pre-Sales Engineer opportunities where I can leverage my PMP methodology, multi-cloud architecture expertise, and proven stakeholder management skills to drive measurable outcomes for enterprise and government organizations.
